usage: 客廳 is used as a noun referring to the living room in a house or apartment.
It can be the subject or object in a sentence when talking about home layout or activities.
客廳 is commonly combined with verbs like 'to clean,' 'to decorate,' or 'to invite' when describing actions.
You can use 客廳 with adjectives to describe its size, brightness, or tidiness.
客廳 is often contrasted with other rooms like 廚房 (kitchen) or 睡房 (bedroom) when discussing rooms.
